preconditions: Editable test-owned Set; no modal dialog/rename entry except explicitly under test; declared Win/macOS platform; original Linux UI support not inferred.

Retain before testing: source bytes/hash/length/rate/depth/channels, sample reference, Clip Start/End/Loop, Warp/markers/mode, tempo/meter, launch quantization, Clip Update Rate, groove/scale, gain/pitch/Hi-Q/Fade, clip active state, output routes/mutes, track/device state and settings/focus.

Future sample A: independently validated owned asymmetric eight-bar audio, 48 kHz 24-bit mono with distinct attacks/sustain and nonzero edges. B: shorter owned audio,44.1 kHz16-bit stereo; C: independently equal-length alternate of A with distinct content. Files are not supplied or claimed executed.
M: editable MIDI clip with two distinct notes and known instrument for audible controls only. MIDI edits/expression/computation remain under their canonical owners.

Audible tests require valid source/held note where applicable, clip/track/master active unmuted, monitoring/routing enabled and nonzero gain. No-effect needs paired active positive baseline and deliberately changed tested control only.
Reset test-owned copies between trials. All actual time/file/PCM/MIDI outputs and target comparisons remain U; expected:null is never a pass.
